description:
Build a day-by-day Camino de Santiago itinerary (walking stages,
        km per day, overnight towns, dates, route map image) following the
        camino's OFFICIAL stages adapted to the pilgrim's daily pace. Use it for
        any Camino itinerary, stage plan or "how many days from
        Sarria/Tui/Porto/Roncesvalles" question: it is the itinerary Ourway books.
        `ritmo`: tranquilo (18-22 km/day) | medio (22-28) | experimentado
        (28-35); use `km_max_etapa` instead for an explicit km cap or cycling
        (~2x). `fecha_inicio` (YYYY-MM-DD, first night) is optional: without it
        dates come back "to be confirmed" — call it anyway. Only pass
        `num_noches` when the client fixes the number of nights. Each stage
        lists `alternativas_pernocta`: nearby towns where the client could
        sleep instead; to apply a change call again with `pernoctas_ids` (the
        overnight town of EVERY night, in walking order; repeat a town on
        consecutive nights for a rest day). Optional edits, all requiring
        `pernoctas_ids`: `solo_paso_final_id` = town reached walking on the
        last day without sleeping there; `extender_hasta_id` = extend the trip
        beyond the last stop up to that town (the new part is split at the
        pace); `camino_continuacion_slug` = route continuing after the goal
        (only `camino-finisterre-muxia`, starting in Santiago). Each stage has
        `tipo` (marcha | descanso | solo_paso), `dia_num`, `noche_num` (null on
        the arrival without night) and `intermedias` (towns inside the stage
        where to stop earlier); `continuaciones` lists where the trip can be
        extended. Returns
        `mapa_url`: a real PNG map of the route with numbered overnight stops —
        show it in the chat right after the stage table (`![Mapa](mapa_url)`).
        / Fuente del itinerario reservable: úsala para proponer o revisar
        etapas, aunque el cliente aún no tenga fecha. Presenta el
        itinerario y pide confirmación ANTES de cotizar. (es: proponer_itinerario)

camino_continuacion_slug.description: Requires pernoctas_ids. Route that continues after the goal; only camino-finisterre-muxia (from Santiago).
camino_continuacion_slug.title: Camino Continuacion Slug

camino_slug.description: Camino route slug from list_camino_routes (e.g. camino-frances).
camino_slug.title: Camino Slug

extender_hasta_id.description: Requires pernoctas_ids. Extend the trip beyond the last stop up to this town ID (see `continuaciones`); the new part is split at the pace.
extender_hasta_id.title: Extender Hasta Id

fecha_inicio.description: Date of the first night, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional: without it dates come back 'to be confirmed'.
fecha_inicio.title: Fecha Inicio

km_max_etapa.description: Explicit cap in km per day (a client's own limit, or ~2x the walking pace when cycling). Overrides ritmo.
km_max_etapa.title: Km Max Etapa

num_noches.description: Number of nights, ONLY when the client fixes it. Omit it and the stages follow the official route and the pace.
num_noches.title: Num Noches

pernoctas_ids.description: Overnight town ID of EVERY night in walking order, to apply changes (alternativas_pernocta); repeat a town on consecutive nights for a rest day.
pernoctas_ids.title: Pernoctas Ids

poblacion_destino_id.description: ID of the final town, from camino_route_towns. Omit to walk to the end of the route (usually Santiago de Compostela).
poblacion_destino_id.title: Poblacion Destino Id

poblacion_inicio_id.description: ID of the starting town (where the first night is spent), from camino_route_towns.
poblacion_inicio_id.title: Poblacion Inicio Id

ritmo.description: Daily walking pace: tranquilo (18-22 km/day) | medio (22-28) | experimentado (28-35). Ignored if km_max_etapa is given.
ritmo.title: Ritmo

solo_paso_final_id.description: Requires pernoctas_ids. Town reached walking on the last day without sleeping there (arrival without night).
solo_paso_final_id.title: Solo Paso Final Id

name: plan_camino_itinerary
title: Plan a Camino itinerary (stages + map)
